quickref.status: BBG unlock, 75 Gas; added Jun 2014 (class log: 2.9); reworked about Oct 1-2, 2014 (probably 2.12): faster fire, base ammo 12 as observed; wiki 'REMOVED' note Nov 10, 2020; seen in live matches on build '2.53.6' in Jun-Jul 2023; 2026 unverified
quickref.look: Glossy red rifle (about #C42920-#9C0001) with white jagged lightning decals, silver ribbed top rail, grey muzzle block, tan block on top at the rear; held at waist height across the body; about 0.45x Sanchez's height
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Very fast automatic; soft pink muzzle glow (#E691B7), white ring flash in one 2016 frame; thin, ruler-straight beam with a white core and pink-magenta edges (#D888C2-#EB70AC) that reads as an instant hit; sound undocumented
quickref.impact_end_result: White spiky starburst (#FEFEFA) at the target plus a wide web of thin branching red lightning arcs (core about #DC1021, pink-red glow #E06F70); damage only, no status icon (wiki: 'slight AOE... deals no damage'); KO look unobserved

open_questions: Is Greased Lightning in the Nov 4, 2026 build? No 2026 still I opened shows Sanchez with it, and the Arbiter chapter (47:23) of the JustNubz showcase is unviewed.

Did Greased Lightning return to the store in 2023 ('Greased lightning returns'), or did owners keep it? Why do 2023 clients read '2.53.6' when the wiki lists a BBG 3.0 on Nov 15, 2021 that removed +1 equipment, while a 2023 HUD shows 17 (12 + Ammo +1)?
What is the true stat history? The observed base magazine is 12 from Oct 2014 to 2023, against the wiki's 14 (Oct 2014), 17 (Nov 2014-2017) and 30 (Mar 2018 edit).
Is the small white flare in pre-rework 2014 stills a different hit effect from the 2015-2016 starburst with red arcs, or just distance and frame choice?
What do a Greased Lightning KO and its firing sound look and sound like? Neither is documented or seen.
